_doc: Element reactions made readable and rewarded (proposal D3, MECHANIK.md M5). src/hell/story_elements.gd reports every reaction it makes (_reacted with one of its REACTIONS ids; each id has an entry here) and shows its sign and name for a moment over the reaction point (draw_hud, popup values). A reaction the hero caused (an owner > 0: his talents, his fireballs, his armour powers, his potions) is entered as discovered in the profile (its reactions list, src/progress/profile.gd) and marks the monsters within its reach plus reward.reach_pad world px; their kill within reward.window s pays reward.hero_exp_mul times the EXP (src/hell/hell_talents.gd killed: the talents' EXP and the run level's). The pause's Elemente page (src/pause_menu.gd set_reactions) lists every entry in order with its sign, cause and effect and marks the discovered ones. icon: 7 rows of 7 pixels, '.' empty, other letters the colours of pal (drawn with an ink rim, popup.cell screen px per pixel on the HUD, 4 on the pause page).

popup._doc: time / new_time / exp_time: seconds a sign shows (a first discovery longer, the EXP reward shorter); lift: screen px over the point, rise: how far it drifts up (eased); pop: seconds the hero's sign is popped by pop_cell extra px per pixel; fade: the last share of its life it fades; other_alpha: signs the monsters or the world caused; merge_time / merge_reach: the same reaction near one still showing renews it (x2, x3 ...); stack: px a different sign near one showing sits higher; max: signs at once.

page.title: ELEMENT-REAKTIONEN
page.hint: Selbst ausgelöste Reaktionen geben +%d %% EP für jeden Gegner, den sie erwischen.

explode.name: Giftexplosion
explode.cause: Feuer oder Lava trifft Gift (Pfütze oder Wolke).
explode.effect: Explodiert, verletzt Gegner ringsum und zündet Gift daneben.

ignite.name: Stichflamme
ignite.effect: Das Gas verpufft in der Luft und verletzt die Gegner darin.

steam.name: Dampf
steam.effect: Eine Dampfwolke steigt auf: sie verbrüht und nimmt die Sicht.

thaw.name: Tauwetter
thaw.effect: Das Eis schmilzt wieder zu Wasser.

freeze.name: Glatteis
freeze.effect: Die Pfütze friert: wer darauf steht, rutscht.

rain.name: Regen
rain.effect: Der Dampf schlägt als Wasserpfütze nieder.

crust.name: Lavakruste
crust.effect: Die Lava erstarrt eine Weile zu harmlosem Stein.

swallow.name: Verschlungen
swallow.effect: Die Leere saugt sie ein; der Leerenmagier nährt damit sein Gefüge.

charge.name: Strom im Wasser
charge.cause: Blitz trifft Wasser, Gift oder Blut.
charge.effect: Die Pfütze steht unter Strom: Gegner darin werden verletzt und betäubt.
